card.name: Start of cardiopulmonary and cardiorespiratory terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of the compound words cardiopulmonary, cardiorespiratory and cardiovascular, such as 'cardi', 'cardio' or 'CARD', right before the rest of the word. It appears in warning text about serious reactions.

modes.label: Cardi- before pulmonary
modes.description: The opening 'cardi' of cardiopulmonary after words like serious, unstable or underlying.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS CARDIOPULMONARY REACTIONS Serious<< cardi>>opulmonary reactions, including fatalities,

modes.label: Cardio- before respiratory or vascular
modes.description: The opening 'cardio' or 'IO' in cardiorespiratory or cardiovascular terms, often in capitalized warnings.
modes.example: and RISK OF ACUTE CARD<<IO>>RESPIRATORY FAILURE IN SUSCEPT

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with word pieces like 'pul' and 'op', which complete cardiopulmonary.
card.plain: It fires on the start of words like cardiopulmonary and cardiorespiratory in warnings, before the word is finished.
